parameters.text:
=Role: Elite Tech Recruiter.

Input Data:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.job_list) }}

Task:

Analyze the 'full_description' of every job.
Select the Top 5 Best Opportunities.
Strict Filtering Rules:

PAYMENT CHECK: Prioritize jobs that mention a "Stipend", "Salary", or "Paid".
REJECT: Immediately reject jobs that explicitly say "Unpaid" (unless the Tech Stack is world-class).
TECH STACK: Rank jobs higher if they mention specific tools: Python, SQL, Pandas, Scikit-learn, AWS.
AVOID: Generic "Data Entry" roles or roles with short, vague descriptions.
Output:
Return RAW JSON Array (Company, Title, Pitch, Link, Location).
Pitch Rule: Your pitch MUST mention the Pay/Stipend (if found) and the Tech Stack.

Example:
[
{
"company": "Company A",
"title": "Data Scientist",
"location": "Remote",
"pitch": "Paid internship (₹15k) focusing on Scikit-learn and predictive modeling.",
"link": "https://...",
"description": "roles, requirements, etc."
}
]

parameters.text:
=Role: You are a professional career writer who specializes in tailoring applications to specific roles.

Job JSON:
{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}

This JSON object includes fields like:

company
title
location
pitch
link
description (full job description text)
My resume:
{{ $item(0).$node["Profile Config"].json.my_resume }}

Task:

Write a concise, high‑impact cover letter (about 150–200 words) tailored specifically to this job and company, using the "description" field as the main source of context.
Suggest 3–5 resume bullet points rewritten to better match this job description, using the job's skills, tools, and responsibilities from the description.
Output STRICTLY as raw JSON with this exact structure (no markdown, no backticks, no extra text).
Copy company and location EXACTLY from the input Job JSON:

{
"company": "EXACT company name from the job JSON",
"location": "EXACT location from the job JSON",
"cover_letter": "full cover letter text here",
"resume_bullets": [
"bullet 1",
"bullet 2",
"bullet 3"
]
}
